long_biography.plain_text:
Richard Alan Kayne began as a securities analyst in New York before managing private accounts, a hedge fund and firm capital at Cantor Fitzgerald. He co-founded Kayne Anderson in 1984 and developed an alternative-investment platform around specialized markets. He also built Kayne Anderson Rudnick into a traditional manager and sold that business in 2001, creating a separate source of founder proceeds.

Kayne remains founder and co-chair of Kayne Anderson. He owns 26.92 percent of the adviser, while employees hold the remaining interests. That equity links him personally to the management company's economics. By contrast, the firm's assets under management represent securities and commitments overseen for funds and clients. Fund assets, portfolio-company values, reported listed positions and transaction totals cannot be assigned to Kayne as personal wealth without separate beneficial-ownership evidence.

uncertainties.detail: The 2025 regulatory brochure reports Kayne's adviser stake at 26.92 percent, replacing older descriptions of him as majority owner. The dossier uses the current disclosed percentage and does not preserve the stale majority label.

Kayne Anderson's AUM represents market value and commitments managed for pooled vehicles, separate accounts and advisory clients. It is not equity owned by Richard Kayne and is not used as a personal-wealth figure.

Historical SEC filings distinguish shares over which Kayne had sole power from much larger positions held or managed jointly through Kayne Anderson entities. No historical or current fund-reported listed position is assigned to him personally without a contemporaneous beneficial-ownership basis.

Kayne Anderson's biography documents the sale of Kayne Anderson Rudnick but does not disclose Kayne's personal proceeds. The sale is treated as a separate wealth-creation event without inventing a transaction value attributable to him.

The 1945 birth year is supported by regulatory brochure material and the current age on Forbes. No reliable public source located establishes an exact birth day, month or place, so those fields remain unproposed.

The owner input links to the Richard Kayne disambiguation page rather than the investor article at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Richard_Kayne_(investor).
